title: Calls to cap ‘mega festival’ crowds over environmental impact
summary: A new peer-reviewed paper has called on licensing bodies to consider capping audience numbers at the industry’s biggest festivals, saying “mega” events cannot cut their environmental impact while continuing to grow.
